I answered Pree in our DM: send the truck to Bay 42.

That comes from what she told me in our DM on Oct 14: Bay 42 is her dock for Tansleigh Packaging pickups on the Quillon project from now on. I also warned her not to confuse it with Dock 14, which she gave me for Tansley Parcel (Larchmont project). She didn't say which project Thursday's pickup is for. So I told her Bay 42 assumes it's Quillon, and that I have no dock on file for any other Tansleigh project.

The answer only uses what she told me herself, and nothing was shared outside her DM.
